newsitem.title: USA: Delaware economic activity index up 0.9 pct in Oct.
newsitem.headline: Delaware economic activity index up 0.9 pct in Oct.

text.p: Delaware's Economic Activity Index rose 0.9 percent in October, the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Tuesday.
The increase resulted from a general improvement in labor conditions, which included increases in hours worked and payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate, the bank said.
Delaware's index increased one percent for the 12 months ending in October.
The national Index of Coincident Indicators compiled by the Conference Board fell 0.1 percent in October and was up three percent over the last 12 months.
The Economic Activity Index for Delaware is constructed from data on payroll employment, average hours worked in manufacturing, and the unemployment rate.
All data are seasonally adjusted by the Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia.
